|printed_lore=''<span lang="ja">アナキン・スカイウォーカーの息子。オビ＝ワン・ケノービの弟子。Ｔ－16スカイホッパーに乗って、ベガーズ・キャニオンのウォンプ・ラットを狙い撃ちして操縦技能を磨いた。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
|translation='''Title:''' Luke Skywalker.

'''Card text:''' If Luke is at a location other than Tatooine, you may activate 1 additional Force each turn. Adds 3 to the power of a starship he pilots. When piloting Red 5, also adds 2 to maneuver. Immune to attrition < 3.

'''Lore:''' Son of Anakin Skywalker. Pupil of Obi-Wan Kenobi. He honed his piloting skill by shooting womp rats in Beggar's Canyon from a T-16 skyhopper.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' Unlike the [[Luke Skywalker (Reflections Foil)|English Reflections foil]], this Japanese foil retains the earlier activation condition (Luke at a location other than Tatooine) and limits the piloting power bonus to a starship. The English foil’s November 1998 revisions instead require that Luke is not at a Tatooine site for the extra activation, and apply the piloting bonus to anything he pilots.<ref name="wording-faces">Printed faces: [[:File:Luke-Skywalker-Reflections-Foil-PSA.jpg|English Reflections foil]] and [[:File:Japanese-Luke-Skywalker-Reflections-III-Foil-SWCA.jpg|Japanese Reflections III foil]].</ref>
|errata_history=[[Decipher Glossary 2.0|Decipher’s Glossary Version 2.0]] publishes the English replacement text on p. 89 and states on p. 2 that its revised gameplay applies to all versions of the affected cards as of November 1998. The Japanese foil’s unchanged printing does not rescind that erratum.<ref name="decipher-1998">[http://decipher.com/starwars/rules/pdf/swccgglossary.pdf Star Wars Customizable Card Game Glossary, Version 2.0], [[Decipher]] (November 1998), pp. 1–2 and 89. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20061215115652/http://decipher.com:80/starwars/rules/pdf/swccgglossary.pdf Internet Archive].</ref>
|notes='''Luke Skywalker (Japanese Reflections III Foil)''' is a Japanese-language foil printing of [[Luke Skywalker|Luke Skywalker]]. [[Decipher]] released it in [[Reflections III: A Collector's Bounty]] in October 2001. The ordinary Japanese expansion printing is [[Luke Skywalker (Japanese)]]. Complete Card List v4 lists checklist R58 at rarity SR. Collector R-numbers are checklist references, not GEMP blueprint IDs.<ref name="checklist">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/swccgcardlist4.0.pdf Star Wars Customizable Card Game Complete Card List v4.0], p. 31, Reflections III foil cards, R58. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261009184033/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/swccgcardlist4.0.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], p. 22. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Luke-Skywalker-Reflections-III-Foil-SWCA.jpg|Original Japanese foil face]]. Photograph by Duncan Jenkins.</ref>
